expected_findings.description: No direct test coverage for the string-typed override path of _matches_type.
The final branch implicitly assumes declared == "string" without explicit checking, so a malformed ExprType would silently be treated as string; should add explicit if or defensiveness comment.
Error message uses inconsistent type vocabulary (ExprType "string" for expectation vs type.__name__ "str" for actual), resulting in confusing messages like "expects string, got str".

apply_var_overrides raises after create_worktree has already created the branch and worktree, leaving an orphaned worktree on validation failure; pre-existing pattern but worth tracking for future cleanup.
A CLI-level test that bad overrides yield rc 2 would be belt-and-suspenders but is YAGNI since exception handling is already shared with other LoadError sources.
